CMR.note: Licence is an arrete of the finance ministry after a COBAC decision; no central bank role stated.
No consumer-protection rule or complaints body stated.
No cross-border channel stated for Cameroon.
No government payments to people stated.
Only account and transaction counts, no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: Cameroon has two licensed payment institutions, Orange Money Cameroun and Mobile Money Corporation (which runs MTN Mobile Money), per DGTCFM data updated July 2026, and mobile money had 30.99 million accounts in 2024 per BEAC.
facts.system: Orange Money Cameroun; MTN Mobile Money

facts.fact: Licensed payment institution Konoom Cameroun plans to let users pay taxes, levies and customs duties from a phone once Konoom Mobile Money launches in the coming months, per Agence Ecofin.
